text:
Glad it all came together! One quick correction before you go: in the A natural minor version, I labeled the second left-hand chord as **C/E**, but the notes I gave (C₃ – E₃ – A₃) are actually **Am/C**, A minor in first inversion. That voicing still works well there. If you want a true C/E instead, play E₃ – G₃ – C₄.

Also, it's about 2 PM on my end (US Eastern), so if it feels late, you may be in a different time zone or just had a long day. Either way, good luck with the motif!
